headword: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}

definitions.explanation: An organized trip taken by students as part of their school education, typically to historical or cultural sites.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}で{京都|きょうと}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Kyoto on a school trip.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}の{思|おも}い{出|で}は{一生|いっしょう}の{宝物|たからもの}だ。
examples.english: Memories of the school trip are lifelong treasures.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}で{友達|ともだち}と{部屋|へや}を{共|とも}にする。
examples.english: To share a room with friends on the school trip.

notes:
{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう} is an important memory for Japanese students, typically lasting several days.

COMMON DESTINATIONS:
- {京都|きょうと}/{奈良|なら}: historical temples and shrines
- {沖縄|おきなわ}: beaches and WWII history
- {広島|ひろしま}: peace memorial
- {東京|とうきょう}ディズニーランド: theme park

TIMING:
Usually held in middle school or high school years.
